candidates.statement: Checkout 502s trace to inventory's redis.reserve_inventory failing with timeout/DependencyUnavailable, causing inventory 503 and order ReadTimeout, propagating 502 to gateway /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No redis-side metrics/logs; gateway dependency metrics empty. Redis timeout inferred from inventory spans only.

report.explanation: Four checkout requests returned 502 at ~2s. Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timing out with DependencyUnavailable, inventory returning 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway 502. Topology confirms inventory->redis. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout. Redis-side telemetry absent, so confidence is moderate.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side latency/error metrics or logs for reserve_inventory during the incident window
Inventory service logs confirming redis timeout as the failing dependency
